newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Barlo says volume, revenue trend positive.
newsitem.headline: Barlo says volume, revenue trend positive.

text.p: Irish radiators and plastics firm Barlo Group Plc said on Tuesday that it continued to benefit from postive trends in volumes and revenue.
"The market remains competitive, especially in continental Europe, but overall the group continues to enjoy positive trends in volumes and revenue," chairman Frank Belton told the annual meeting.
Barlo said it had completed an extensive investment and modernisation of its manufacturing facilities and finalised a comprehensive restructuring programme during the last three years.
"The benefits of these investments were apparent in the year to March 31, 1997 and will continue in the current year," Belton said.
The group said it achieved record profitabiliy in its radiator activities and grew its overall level of radiator sales to a West European market share of around 10 percent in the last financial year.
"Further growth is planned in the current year which is supported by sales levels in the first quarter," the chairman said.
Further progress is also planned in the group's plastic activities, he said.
